registered_predictions.analysis: tf_interp3.py verbatim, the same code path that produced the depth-1/2 and six-architecture numbers; the depth-1/2 vanilla cells that had no interp3 JSON are backfilled through the same path so the ladder is one code path end to end

P1_induction_width_threshold.the_fact_being_extrapolated: at depth 2 the plain model's synthetic induction score is +0.0938 +- 0.0086 at width 256 (3/3 seeds above the planted-oracle power floor) and is BELOW its own floor at widths 32/64/128 at every seed; four of five interpretable variants induct at width 128 at depth 2
P1_induction_width_threshold.prediction: depth LOWERS the width threshold by one octave. Concretely: at depth 3, width 128 shows induction above the planted-oracle 3-SE floor at >= 2 of 3 seeds, with a mean score in [+0.015, +0.070]; at depth 4, width 128 does so at 3 of 3 seeds. Width 64 stays below floor at BOTH depths 3 and 4 at >= 2 of 3 seeds.
P1_induction_width_threshold.quantitative_side_prediction: the width-256 score GROWS with depth: d3 w256 in [+0.12, +0.35] and d4 w256 >= d3 w256, both above the d2 w256 value of +0.094
P1_induction_width_threshold.falsifier: if d3/d4 width 128 stays below floor at 2 or 3 seeds, the threshold is a WIDTH threshold that depth does not move, and P1 is refuted

P2_attention_to_attention_route.the_fact_being_extrapolated: at depth 2 the causal read-deletion KL for layer-0 attention out of layer 1's Q/K/V read is 2.4e-5 / 9.8e-6 / 4.7e-6 (zero) and 5.5e-6 / 4.0e-6 / 3.5e-6 (resample) across three seeds, while deleting the first MLP's write from the same read costs 1.796 nats -- a ratio of ~1e-5
P2_attention_to_attention_route.prediction: the FEED-FORWARD path keeps dominating all the way up. For every layer l in 1..L-1 and every upstream attention module A_j (j<l), the causal read-deletion KL of A_j stays below 1% of the largest MLP read-deletion KL at the same layer, at every width and every seed. The single largest contributor to each layer's read is the IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING MLP, M_{l-1}.
P2_attention_to_attention_route.the_one_place_it_might_break: if any attention-to-attention route becomes non-negligible (>1% of the dominant MLP term) it will be at the DEEPEST layer of the depth-4 models and at width 256 -- the only cells with both a spare layer and enough width to have built induction. Registered as the pre-specified exception so that finding it there is not treated as a refutation of the main clause and finding it anywhere else is.
P2_attention_to_attention_route.falsifier: any attention-to-attention read-deletion KL above 1% of its layer's dominant MLP term, at 2+ seeds, outside the named exception

P3_held_CE.shape: diminishing returns per added layer, and the per-layer gain GROWS with width (d1->d2 gains were -0.095/-0.130/-0.176/-0.234 at w32/64/128/256, so depth pays more where there is width to spend it)

P4_ladder_order_dependence.the_fact_being_extrapolated: at depth 2 attention is worth 8.17 nats added first and 0.61 added last, an 11-13x order dependence with a 3.8-7.6 nat interaction term
P4_ladder_order_dependence.prediction: the attention/MLP order dependence GROWS with depth: the ratio attention_marginal_first / attention_marginal_last exceeds its depth-2 value at the same width, at >= 2 of 3 seeds, at every width, and the interaction term (first minus last) grows monotonically in depth at width 256
